gate.vectorAndLag: passed on macOS arm64 and compiled Linux arm64
gate.costDecision: Accepted for default-off implementation. Sustained production memory acceptance remains pending.

method.isolation: One fresh process per case, driver, and round. One SQL connection per measured process. Seed process and serialization processes are separate.
method.order: Two rounds: sqlite then worker, worker then sqlite. Ten samples per ordinary driver per round. Three samples per long driver per round.
method.gc: Bun.gc(true) in both active JavaScript threads before every warmup and sample. Result arrays are explicitly emptied before the next GC boundary.
method.memoryWindow: Starts after warmup GC. Includes queries, transport, separate JSON decoding, heap snapshots, and comparable GC boundaries. Value hashing occurs after the window.
method.rss: External process sampling continues during work. macOS uses ps RSS in KiB. Linux uses /proc/PID/status VmRSS, RssAnon, and RssFile in KiB.
method.rssPeaks: Sampled lower bounds. Each component maximum is independent and can occur at a different instant. No process.memoryUsage RSS or cumulative maxRSS is used.
method.heap: Thread-local JSC heapSize, heapCapacity, extraMemorySize, and objectCount snapshots. These do not attribute SQLite/native/mmap memory.
method.lag: transportLagMs excludes explicit JSON parsing. decodeLagMs uses a separate armed probe. Transport still includes Bun message deserialization.
method.calibration: Every fresh long-query process calibrates its own thread with three SQL samples per step. Reports iterations, step times, and ns/iteration.
method.transfer: Bun JSC serialized bytes exclude protocol headers. Local serialization, deserialization, and clone tests run in other processes.
method.limits: Synthetic reads on native arm64. External sampling perturbs scheduling and can miss short peaks. OS file caches remain warm. Production keeps a boot connection and adds DbClient behavior that this spike does not measure.

macOS.method: Fresh process per case, driver, and round. Order sqlite/worker then worker/sqlite. Separate seed and transfer processes. External RSS sampling during work. Explicit synchronous GC in each active JS thread before warmups and samples.
